description.value: Quarterway Pub is a well-established neighbourhood bar on Bowen Road in Nanaimo, offering a full menu of appetizers and mains alongside a busy events calendar including karaoke nights, NHL game-day specials, and a monthly meat draw. It markets itself as Nanaimo's go-to bar, suggesting a lively, community-centred atmosphere that draws regulars throughout the week. A touring cyclist finishing a ride through the mid-island corridor would find a sit-down meal and cold drinks in a classic pub setting.
